data.title: bn-1v5m: nm tool mode authority derives from preapproval
data.description: Fix stale hardcoded expected_mode=0o555 for the release-proof nm tool in profile_adapters._validate_release_compile_out_authority. nm is the live system /usr/bin/nm (0o755); derive expected_mode from the preapproval authority (release_compile_out.nm.identity.mode) exactly as evidence_schema.validate_preapproval_nm_authority does, so the two validators cannot diverge. Tests: test_profile_adapters 46/46, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. Verified: (1) fix derives nm mode from the same preapproval authority (release_compile_out.nm.identity.mode) that evidence_schema.validate_preapproval_nm_authority uses, so the two validators cannot diverge; (2) evidence_schema already requires this nm authority present, so the new guard introduces no false fail-stop beyond what canonical validation already enforces; (3) binaries at 0o555 correctly unchanged (pinned children); (4) test fixture now models the preapproval nm authority faithfully. open_findings=0
